profile.text: Lappland, unemployed. The only daughter of Alberto Saluzzo, patriarch of the Siracusan Famiglia Saluzzo. She is currently separated from her family. Lappland excels in solo combat, and often assists Rhodes Island in tactical Arts assaults and elimination operations.
